records.scope: Flask application implementing the remax.com mirror: homepage with hero carousel and Homes-for-Sale-Near-Me carousel, state/city property search with the upstream filter bar (status, home type, price, beds/baths, open-house-only, sort), listing detail pages (gallery, presented-by office block, open-house schedule, description, quick overview, six expandable fact sections, contact/tour forms), rentals table and rental detail pages, new-listings table, open-house directories, agent and office finders with filters and detail pages, REMAX Collection and Golf Lifestyles pages, advice/blog hub with 21 articles, scored site-wide search, auth (login/register), account area (favorites, saved searches, inquiries, listing alerts, profile edit), newsletter and listing-alert signups, and the 404 page.

Deterministic build-time seeder. All content rows come from the tracked source_data_listings.json / source_data_rentals.json / source_data_agents.json / source_data_offices.json / source_data_content.json snapshots; benchmark users use a frozen bcrypt hash so the SQLite seed is byte-reproducible on every build (PYTHONHASHSEED=0).

431 real for-sale listings captured from remax.com city search pages on 2026-09-24 (18 city searches across WA/TX/FL/CO/IL/GA/NC/AZ/PA/CA): price, beds, baths, sqft, home type, address, status badges, listing broker/agent/phone, MLS numbers, card photos; 87 listings additionally carry full detail-page data captured from their home-details pages (descriptions, quick overviews, interior/building/exterior/utilities/area/financial fact sections, open-house schedules, gallery photos, presented-by office blocks, listing agent/office lines).

97 real rental rows from remax.com/new-rentals captured 2026-09-24 (address, monthly price, beds, baths, sqft, date added); the 28 rentals whose upstream home-details pages were captured additionally carry descriptions, quick overviews, presented-by blocks and photo galleries.

24 real RE/MAX agents captured from remax.com/real-estate-agents and their detail pages on 2026-09-24: names, titles, licensed states, cities, office names, phones, headshots, about texts, hobbies, civic activities, years of experience, license numbers, languages, specialties and designations.

24 real RE/MAX offices captured from remax.com/real-estate-offices and their detail pages on 2026-09-24: names, addresses, phones, office photos, about texts, service areas, languages and specialties.
21 real blog.remax.com articles captured 2026-09-24 (titles, full body text, hero images), the homepage persona/advice/guide copy, and the popular-cities footer link sets.
Provenance record for every downloaded media byte stream: path under static/images/ (or static/fonts/), byte size, SHA-256 and the exact upstream URL each file was fetched from on 2026-09-24.

Tracked manifest (generated by build_inventory.py) checked by scripts/check_asset_inventory.py during the image build: exact coverage of static/images/ with per-file byte size, SHA-256 and upstream source URL.

884 real media files (64.4 MB) served by remax.com and its image CDNs on 2026-09-24: listing photos (photos.prod.cirrussystem.net), agent and office headshots (papiphotos.remax-im.com), brand/homepage/persona/advice assets (static-images.remax.com), and blog article images (res.cloudinary.com/remax-prod, blog.remax.com).
The Montserrat webfonts remax.com serves (the woff2 subset from www.remax.com static media and the variable TTF from calculators.remax.com), so the mirror renders in the upstream typography offline.

Stylesheet reproducing the upstream design tokens captured on 2026-09-24: Montserrat typography, cream background (#FAF9F5), navy (#000E35), primary blue (#0043FF), link blue (#0022FF), square uppercase CTAs, badge chips, filter bar, listing cards, LDP layout, people cards, advice grid, newsletter band, footer.
Vanilla JS for the filter dropdowns, the gallery-view lightbox and the hero carousel dots.

24 Jinja2 templates (base layout with the upstream header variants, homepage, state directory/state pages, city SRP, listing detail, rental detail, new-listings/rentals tables, open-house pages, agent/office finders and details, luxury, golf, advice hub and articles, search, auth, account, favorites, 404).

The Playwright capture pipeline used to build the source snapshots: city SRP scraper, listing-detail scraper, agent/office scrapers, rentals/blog scrapers, the asset downloader, and build_source_data.py which normalizes the raw captures into the tracked source_data_*.json files.
Raw Playwright captures (rendered HTML, screenshots, JSON). Gitignored and dockerignored; never shipped. All runtime data lives in the seed database rebuilt from the tracked source snapshots.
pytest self-checks: route smoke tests over every page type, seed-integrity checks, search/filter behavior, auth-gated flows and form persistence.

20 goal-style benchmark tasks (search/filter/compare chains, open-house scheduling, agent finding, account management, rentals, advice research). Contributor rows carry only web_name, id, ques, web, upstream_url.
